q: When the angel of the LORD came, what was Gideon doing in a winepress?
why: He was hiding from the Midianites.
quote: where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.

q: What did the angel of the LORD call Gideon when he first appeared?
why: God saw what Gideon could become.
quote: The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.

q: What did Gideon put on the threshing floor to test God's promise?
why: He asked for a sign with dew.
quote: I will place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor.

q: Before fighting Midian, what did God tell Gideon about his army?
why: Israel must not boast it saved itself.
quote: You have too many people for Me to deliver Midian into their hands

q: How many men lapped the water and stayed in Gideon's army?
why: God saved Israel with a small band.
quote: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men

q: Besides a ram's horn, what did each of Gideon's men carry?
a: A jar with a torch inside
why: They broke the jars at night.
quote: gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.

q: What did Gideon's three hundred men shout around the Midianite camp?
a: A sword for the LORD and Gideon!
why: Then the enemy fled.
quote: A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!

q: When Gideon's men blew horns and broke jars, what did the Midianite army do?
why: God gave the victory.
quote: and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.

q: Before Samson was born, what did the angel say must never touch his head?
why: He was a Nazirite from birth.
quote: And no razor shall come over his head

q: Which enemies would Samson begin to save Israel from?
why: The angel told his mother.
quote: and he will begin the deliverance of Israel from the hand of the Philistines.

q: When a young lion roared at Samson, what did he do?
why: The Spirit came on him powerfully.
quote: and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands

q: What was the name of the woman Samson loved in the Valley of Sorek?
why: The Philistines paid her to trick him.
quote: Samson fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

q: What did Samson finally tell Delilah was the secret of his strength?
why: He was a Nazirite to God.
quote: My hair has never been cut, because I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb.

q: While Samson was in prison, what began to grow back?
why: His strength would return.
quote: However, the hair of his head began to grow back after it had been shaved.

q: At the end, what did Samson push on to bring down the Philistine temple?
why: He prayed for strength once more.
quote: And Samson reached out for the two central pillars supporting the temple.

q: In the time of the Judges, whom did the LORD raise up to save Israel?
why: They rescued Israel from raiders.
quote: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.

q: Which prophetess was judging Israel when Barak led the army?
why: She sat under a palm tree.
quote: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.

q: How does the book of Judges describe Israel when there was no king?
why: It was a time of trouble.
quote: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.

q: Where did Deborah sit when Israelites came to her for judgment?
why: It was in the hill country of Ephraim.
quote: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel

q: What did Barak say to Deborah before going to battle?
a: I'll go only if you go
why: Deborah agreed to go with him.
quote: If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.

q: Deborah told Barak that the enemy commander Sisera would fall into whose hand?
why: Barak would get no honor.
quote: because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman.

q: To which mountain did Deborah tell Barak to march with ten thousand men?
why: God would draw out Sisera.
quote: Go and march to Mount Tabor

q: When God called Gideon, what did He tell him to go in?
why: God was sending him.
quote: Go in the strength you have and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Am I not sending you?

q: Why did Gideon say he could not save Israel?
a: He was the youngest of a weak clan
why: God promised to be with him.
quote: my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my father’s house.

q: In Gideon's first test, how much water did he wring from the fleece?
why: Only the fleece was wet.
quote: he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.

q: In Gideon's second fleece test, what happened?
why: Dew covered the ground instead.
quote: Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.

q: When Gideon let the fearful go home, how many remained?
why: Twenty-two thousand turned back.
quote: So twenty-two thousand of them turned back, but ten thousand remained.

q: How did God choose Gideon's three hundred at the water?
why: Those who lapped were kept.
quote: Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel to drink.

q: What did Manoah's wife name the son the angel promised her?
why: The LORD blessed the boy.
quote: So the woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson.

q: What did Samson use to strike down a thousand Philistines?
why: God gave him strength.
quote: He found the fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached out his hand and took it, and struck down a thousand men.

q: How many braids of Samson's hair were shaved off?
why: Then his strength left him.
quote: she called a man to shave off the seven braids of his head.

q: When Samson woke after his hair was cut, what did he not know?
why: His strength was gone.
quote: But he did not know that the LORD had departed from him.

q: In prison in Gaza, what was Samson forced to do?
why: He was bound with bronze shackles.
quote: and forced to grind grain in the prison.

q: In the Philistine temple, what did Samson ask God?
why: He prayed before pushing the pillars.
quote: Strengthen me, O God, just once more

q: Who was the first deliverer God raised up in Judges, a relative of Caleb?
why: He was the son of Caleb's younger brother.
quote: He raised up Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them.

q: Which deliverer in Judges was a left-handed Benjamite?
why: He was sent to Eglon king of Moab.
quote: He raised up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer.

q: Sisera was the army commander of which king?
why: His army was drawn to the Kishon.
quote: And I will draw out Sisera the commander of Jabin’s army

q: To which river did God draw Sisera's army in Deborah's day?
why: God delivered him to Barak.
quote: his chariots, and his troops to the River Kishon

q: Under the oak in which town did the angel find Gideon?
why: It belonged to Joash his father.
quote: the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite

q: At what time of night did Gideon's men attack the Midianite camp?
a: The beginning of the middle watch
why: Just after the guard changed.
quote: at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the changing of the guard.

q: Into how many companies did Gideon divide his three hundred men?
why: They surrounded the camp.
quote: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies

q: What was the name of Samson's father?
why: He was a Danite from Zorah.
quote: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites

q: Near which town's vineyards did a young lion attack Samson?
why: He tore it apart.
quote: and came to the vineyards of Timnah. Suddenly a young lion came roaring at him

q: How much silver did each Philistine lord promise Delilah?
why: They wanted Samson's secret.
quote: Then each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver.

q: About how many people were on the roof of the Philistine temple watching Samson?
why: All the lords were there too.
quote: and about three thousand men and women were on the roof watching Samson entertain them.
